item.title: October 2026 Festivals Around Korea — Gangwon, Chungcheong, Jeolla, Gyeongsang, Jeju
item.description: Festivals outside the Seoul area for the rest of October 2026: Gangneung Coffee Festival, Jinju Lantern Festival, Jeongeup Gujeolcho Festival, Tamna Cultural Festival, Hampyeong Chrysanthemum Festival and more, with dates, venues, fees, shuttles and highlights.

item.title: October 2026 Festivals in Seoul, Gyeonggi and Incheon
item.description: Festivals in the Seoul capital area for the rest of October 2026: silver grass at Haneul Park, Hanseong Baekje Festival, Jeongdong Night Walk, Icheon Rice Festival, Yeoju Ogok Naru Festival and more, with dates, venues, fees, transport and highlights.
